metadata.description: Merget's plugin for coding agents: set Merget up, operate its merge queue, and read its findings and code graphs.

plugins.description: Merget is a semantic merge queue for GitHub. This plugin connects your coding agent to Merget's MCP server and adds four skills: set Merget up, operate its merge queue, read a pull request's findings and verdict, and query its code property graphs.
plugins.name: merget
